items.title: Rework companions: 15 per rarity, four summon bands, and brand-new Common roster
items.quote: "I want to rework all companions so far, have 4 tiers of pull chances within a rarity (abberitions are a big jump as it is currently, the other should be pretty close like within a few percentage, just for variety), have 15 per rarity, and I want al currently created companions to move up a rarity and common kept free for us to remake. Feel free to switch any around to different rarities than they are if they look cooler"

asks.text: Summon chances for every rarity at every Portal level. Only Uncommon, Rare and Epic can be rolled under the new plan, and the Legendary to Eternal chances aren't set yet (#78). I suggest deciding them in #78 first. Then this request can use them.

Power. Under today's damage rule, moving up one rarity doubles a companion's base damage, so 38 companions would hit 4 times as hard and 3 would hit 8 times as hard. That would make story bosses much easier. I suggest one of two fixes: keep each companion's current damage…

A save update that keeps everyone's owned companions, mastery, Essence, claims and waiting summons exactly as they are. I suggest building it last, once the new Commons, chances and power are settled, and testing it on a made-up save first.

Mastery (how many copies each mastery level needs) for the new rarities. Today's tables stop at Rare. Epic is a draft in #89, and Epic Aberration, Legendary and Mythic have none. I suggest using the Rare table for all of them until balance numbers are approved.

The 15 new Common companions are needed before new players can start. A new player's Portal is 100% Common today. I suggest designing them next, with one Aberration among them, and putting their art in your Artwork Inbox's Approved folder.
Do you want to move any companion to a different rarity once you've seen the art side by side? I suggest keeping the request's list for now and changing names later in a short Changes note.

Most companions move up two rarities, because only 15 fit in each one. Is that OK, or should more of them stop at one step? I suggest keeping two steps, so that Uncommon, Rare and Epic each have a full 15 right away.
